## Type of change

- [ ] `feat`: new functionality
- [ ] `fix`: bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `chore` / `build` / `ci`: tooling, dependencies or configuration
- [ ] `refactor` / `perf` / `style`: no behaviour change

## Area

- [ ] Client (`client/`)
- [ ] API (`server/`, `api/`)
- [ ] Deployment (`vercel.json`, root `package.json`)
- [ ] Repository and documentation

## How was this tested?

<!-- Commands run and flows checked by hand, e.g. `npm run build` in client/, inquiry submitted against a dev database. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] The branch name uses `feature/`, `fix/`, `chore/` or `docs/`.
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes in `client/`.
- [ ] `node --check` passes for the changed files in `server/` and `api/`.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]` for user-facing or operational changes.
- [ ] New or renamed environment variables are added to the matching `.env.example` and the README.
- [ ] No secrets, real `.env` files or personal data are included.
- [ ] Changes to `vercel.json` or the root `build` / `postinstall` scripts were checked on a Vercel preview deployment.
